title: Intelligent WSN Sensor Node for Oil Spill Detection and Classification: A TinyML and IoT Approach
notes: Direct 2026 IEEE base paper for petroleum-derivative detection using water-quality variables and embedded ML.

title: LADOS: Aerial Imagery Dataset for Oil Spill Detection, Classification, and Localization Using Semantic Segmentation
notes: Public RGB aerial dataset with pixel-level oil-related annotations; strong candidate for segmentation experiments.

title: Pixel-level detection and classification of marine oil spills in aerial imagery with annotation uncertainty handling
notes: Directly relevant to RGB pixel-level segmentation, U-Net comparison, and annotation uncertainty.

title: A dataset of drone-captured, segmented images for oil spill detection in port environments
notes: Public RGB drone dataset with segmentation masks; useful for validation/domain-shift analysis.

title: Monitoring offshore oil pollution using multi-class convolutional neural networks
notes: Direct classification-versus-segmentation comparison using VGG16, Mask R-CNN and PSPNet.

title: A Review of Artificial Intelligence and Remote Sensing for Marine Oil Spill Detection, Classification, and Thickness Estimation
notes: Broad review useful for survey framing, modalities, datasets and research gaps; not primary experimental evidence.

title: Remote sensing for marine oil spill detection, mapping, and monitoring: A systematic review and bibliometric analysis
notes: High-level systematic/bibliometric context for the survey paper.

title: A Deep-Learning Framework for the Detection of Oil Spills from SAR Data
notes: Relevant SAR deep-learning detection/segmentation study; supports comparison with RGB approaches.

title: Large-Scale Detection and Categorization of Oil Spills from SAR Images with Deep Learning
notes: Large-scale SAR segmentation/categorization reference; useful for remote-monitoring context.

title: Ocean oil spill detection from SAR images based on multi-channel deep learning semantic segmentation
notes: Important multimodal remote-sensing example using SAR, variance and wind-field channels.

title: A self-evolving deep learning algorithm for automatic oil spill detection in Sentinel-1 SAR images
notes: Useful for data scarcity, hard negatives/look-alikes and iterative training discussion.

title: Marine oil spill detection and segmentation in SAR data with two steps Deep Learning framework
notes: Direct classification-plus-segmentation comparison; relevant to the distinction between detection and segmentation.

title: Deep Learning-Based Detection of Oil Spills in Pakistan’s Exclusive Economic Zone from January 2017 to December 2023
notes: Regional SAR dataset/study useful for domain shift and geographic generalization discussion.

title: Sentinel-1 SAR Oil spill image dataset for train, validate, and test deep learning models. Part I
notes: Public dataset useful for reproducibility and future SAR benchmarking.

title: Oil Spill Segmentation Dataset (800x600)
notes: Small public SAR image-mask dataset; useful as an additional reproducibility benchmark, not an RGB substitute.

title: Handheld UV fluorescence spectrophotometer device for the classification and analysis of petroleum oil samples
notes: Shows an alternative petroleum-specific sensing modality and helps distinguish chemical/spectroscopic sensing from RGB vision.
